g.desc: STILL TO CHECK before building this version

g.text: - The car's outlet: that it is off when the car is off, and its rating (usually 120 W / 10 A on a ~15 A fuse; check the owner's

g.desc: - The car's outlet: that it is off when the car is off, and its rating (usually 120 W / 10 A on a ~15 A fuse; check the owner's

g.text: - U1 and the Qi module must accept up to ~14.6 V (the original controller's label says 5-12 V).

g.desc: - U1 and the Qi module must accept up to ~14.6 V (the original controller's label says 5-12 V).

g.text: - The original button latches; its current rating is unknown. Specify a switch rated 2 A DC or more.

g.desc: - The original button latches; its current rating is unknown. Specify a switch rated 2 A DC or more.

g.desc: Fuse F4 2 A. The silver push button SW1 is the only control on the console: press it and the RGB lights come on. It

g.desc: modes are set in the phone app.

g.desc: U1 drives three aluminium RGB LED heads through the 1-to-3 splitter J3 (4 wires each: V+ common anode, R, G, B).

g.desc: H1 and H2 shine into the side-glow fibres along the tops of the two side arms. Mount H3 properly or remove it.

g.desc: - Red = +12 V and black = earth, everywhere.
